text.p: Tropical Cyclone Daniella (08S) is a major threat to the island of Mauritius. TC 08S is centered near 20s/56e or just northeast of Mauritius and is moving south-southeastward at 12 mph. Top winds are near 100 mph. This system will bring heavy rains, high, damaging winds, a powerful coastal storm surge, and widespread flooding and property damage to Mauritius over the next 6-12 hours before the system begins to weaken and turn more east-southeasterly over open waters.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY STATEMENTS AT THIS TIME
